title: Time Optimization
intro: 14 days at relaxed pace. "Early" = 8–9 AM at sites (not 6 AM) to match late-morning profile. 70% rule fits Vietnam flexibility; border days 6, 8, 14 run at 100%.

tables.caption: Transit Time Minimization
rows: Red-eye US→China (Sun eve arrive Mon/Tue AM)

bullets.heading: PTO Hacking
items: Optimal: depart Sat Aug 30 or Sun Aug 31; arrive Beijing Mon Sept 1 (Labor Day 2026 = Sept 7)
Return Sat Sept 13 or Sun Sept 14 — weekend travel saves PTO
Net PTO: ~9 days (Mon Sept 1–Fri Sept 12) vs 10 with midweek-only travel
Power play: +1 PTO Sept 15 → extra Đà Nẵng resort night (~$700–1,400)

bullets.heading: Jet Lag (US → Beijing, +12 hr Eastern)
items: Flight: stay awake until local 9–10 PM; align from Day 1
Day 1: no nap; afternoon light walk; bed 10 PM; alarm 8 AM
Melatonin 0.5–1 mg local bedtime Days 1–2 (not 5–10 mg)
Resolved by Day 3 (Great Wall); return eastbound easier in 2–3 days

bullets.heading: Activity Clustering
items: Beijing: Forbidden City → Jingshan → Wangfujing (1.5 km); Wall Day 3 standalone; Summer Palace standalone
Hanoi: Hoan Kiem → Ngoc Son → 36 Streets → Dong Xuan → Ta Hien (1 km walk)
Đà Nẵng: Son Trà + Mỹ Khê north; Marble Mts → Hội An south; My Son own day

bullets.heading: Power Play (+2–3 PTO)
items: Best extension: Sept 15–16 extra Đà Nẵng resort (beach, Cham Islands weather window, Hội An shopping)
Alt: Aug 28 depart for +2 Beijing days (Xi'an Terra Cotta day trip)
Recommendation: resort extension over Xi'an for this profile

callouts.text: Border days 6, 8, 14 at 100% schedule — only days with zero flex
Book now: Da Dong Peking Duck, NON La Đà Nẵng, White Rose Hội An (weeks ahead)
Depart Sun Aug 31 instead of Tue Sept 1 saves 1 PTO; Day 1 light recovery intact
